doc: Public-demo compatibility contract (owner clarification 2026-11-08). Authorization changes are action/resource-scoped: no blanket authentication at domain, subdomain, router, middleware or /m/* level on intentionally-public demo hosts. A documented public journey returning anything but its pinned response is a RELEASE BLOCKER. 'local' = the repo app runnable with TestClient (CI functionality+containment); 'live' = the hosted surface (nightly availability+response contract, scripts/probe_public_demo.py). classification pending-owner entries pin TODAY's behaviour so nothing changes silently. Baseline captured 2026-11-08 (audit 2026-11-08 §10).
